seoTitle: Volusia County Schools Calendar 2025-2026: Holidays, Breaks & PDF
seoDescription: Volusia County Schools 2025-2026 calendar with Aug 11 first day, May 28 last day, holidays, breaks, early release dates, Spanish PDF and ICS.
calendarNotes: Volusia County Schools starts the 2025-2026 school year on Monday, August 11, 2025 and ends the student year on Thursday, May 28, 2026. Thanksgiving Break begins November 24, Winter Break begins December 22 with classes resuming January 6, and Spring Break runs March 16-20. The revised calendar states that September 22 is a professional development day that will be used as an inclement-weather make-up day if needed, and it separately notes that Thanksgiving week will not include make-up days.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Volusia County school start in 2025?
calendarFaqs.a: Volusia County Schools starts the 2025-2026 school year for students on Monday, August 11, 2025.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for Volusia County in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: The last day of school for Volusia County students is Thursday, May 28, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Volusia County Spring Break in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break begins Monday, March 16, 2026. Classes resume Monday, March 23, so the main student break runs March 16-20.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Volusia County Winter Break in 2025-2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break begins Monday, December 22, 2025. January 5 is a teacher duty day/student holiday, and classes resume Tuesday, January 6, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: Which Volusia County 2025-2026 date is an inclement-weather make-up day?
calendarFaqs.a: The official revised calendar identifies Monday, September 22, 2025 as a professional development day that will be used as a make-up day for inclement weather if needed.

calendarFaqs.q: Does Volusia publish a Spanish calendar for 2025-2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. Volusia County Schools publishes a Spanish version of the 2025-2026 school calendar, linked as an alternate official calendar on this page.
